verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit names a "Pre-Merge Checks" feature tied to its request-changes workflow, which can block a PR. Its path instructions accept plain-language guidance such as coverage requirements for tests or clarity rules for docs, applied during automatic PR reviews. However, no evidence shows users authoring their own custom pre-merge checks in natural language, or such checks running as discrete pass/fail gates on every PR. Missing for 10: documentation of user-defined plain-language pre-merge checks, evidence of per-PR pass/fail check results and enforcement, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I define custom agentic pre-merge checks in plain language — 'docs updated', 'tests cover new paths' — that run on every PR

citations.quote: Use request changes workflow to keep review decisions synchronized with resolved feedback, completed reviews, and Pre-Merge Checks.
Path instructions apply targeted guidance to specific paths, such as security checks for API controllers, coverage requirements for tests, or clarity rules for documentation.
Within moments of opening a pull request, CodeRabbit analyzes your code with multiple AI models and provides actionable feedback
